Episodes.Title: Live Another Day
Episodes.Actors: Byeon Woo-seok, Kim Hye-yoon, Song Geon-hee
Episodes.Plot: After getting into an accident, Sol finds hope through a phone call from singer Seon Jae. Years later, she attends his concert only to witness his death, mysteriously traveling back in time to 2008 when Seon Jae was alive.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Protect You
Episodes.Actors: Byeon Woo-seok, Kim Hye-yoon, Song Geon-hee
Episodes.Plot: Confused Sol realizes she must save Seon Jae, though can't reveal the future. She attempts befriending him, facing difficulties as Tae Sung grows curious about her sudden change and Seon Jae is bothered by her abrupt appearance.

Episodes.Title: It's All About the Timing
Episodes.Actors: Lee Seung-Hyub, Han Sang Chul, Song Geon-hee
Episodes.Plot: Seon Jae, a talented swimmer, wins gold but gets injured during practice. As he contemplates quitting, Sol tries supporting him, leading to a romantic confession.

Episodes.Title: Sun Jae Sings
Episodes.Actors: Lee Seung-Hyub, Song Geon-hee, Seo Hye-won
Episodes.Plot: Sun Jae saves Sol's life, inspiring her to live fully. Tae Seong envies Sun Jae's closeness with Sol. Despite Sol's objections, Sun Jae temporarily joins Tae Seong's band as a vocalist, winning a prize that displeases Sol.

Episodes.Title: Episode #1.6
Episodes.Actors: Byeon Woo-seok, Kim Hye-yoon, Song Geon-hee

Episodes.Title: How About Now?
Episodes.Actors: Byeon Woo-seok, Kim Hye-yoon, Song Geon-hee
Episodes.Plot: Sol and Sun Jae reunite as promised at Hangang Bridge. Fearing separation, Sol convinces Sun Jae to spend the night together, leading to a realization of their feelings. An unexpected incident leaves Sol distressed.

Episodes.Title: Sol Goes Back Again
Episodes.Actors: Byeon Woo-seok, Kim Hye-yoon, Song Geon-hee
Episodes.Plot: A new attack leaves Sun Jae critically hurt. The changed timeline prompts Sol's time travel to his college as a student. Paths repeatedly cross despite her efforts to avoid him. Sun Jae gets a US rehab training opportunity.

Episodes.Title: I Figured It All Out
Episodes.Actors: Byeon Woo-seok, Kim Hye-yoon, Song Geon-hee
Episodes.Plot: Sun Jae informs Sol about his rehabilitation training in the US. In Hyuk invites Sun Jae to audition with his band. Tae Seong learns of Sol's kidnapping and visits her. Sun Jae departs for the US.

Episodes.Title: Become a Couple
Episodes.Actors: Byeon Woo-seok, Kim Hye-yoon, Song Geon-hee
Episodes.Plot: After admitting their feelings, Sol and Sun Jae cherish their time together. A misunderstanding leads to Kim's arrest. In Hyuk's band performs for the last time while trying to help him.

Episodes.Plot: Kim escapes with Sun Jae, who protects Sol. They meet Geum and Hyun Ju, learning of their bond. In Hyuk quits the band, returning home. Sun Jae, Sol, and Tae Seong visit him, saying Eclipse may debut. Sol notices the future has ch...

Episodes.Actors: Byeon Woo-seok, Kim Hye-yoon, Song Geon-hee
Episodes.Plot: Sol leaves Sun Jae after lying to him. He returns to Seoul. Attempting to find her Sol ignores his calls. Meanwhile, she conspires with Detective Kim to trap Kim Young Soo, exploiting her foreknowledge of an incident's timing and ...

Episodes.Title: The Wrong Script
Episodes.Actors: Byeon Woo-seok, Kim Hye-yoon, Song Geon-hee
Episodes.Plot: After a mix-up at an award show, actor Sun Jae becomes obsessed with a script Sol wrote, determined to star in it despite her protests. As the situation spirals, Sol contemplates quitting her job.

Episodes.Title: Memories Don't Disappear
Episodes.Actors: Byeon Woo-seok, Kim Hye-yoon, Song Geon-hee
Episodes.Plot: Sol passes out on a Ferris wheel. Sun Jae takes her home, developing feelings for her despite her desire for boundaries. Sun Jae experiences visions around Sol. He joins her movie, but she quits before a meeting.

Episodes.Title: I Remember Everything
Episodes.Actors: Lee Seung-Hyub, Song Geon-hee, Seo Hye-won
Episodes.Plot: After regaining his memory, Sun Jae reconciles with Sol, thanks to Tae Seong's help. Eager to propose, he decides to attend Sol's nephew's first birthday party to meet her family.
